answer: Anyone running 15 aliases therefore needs 56 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in quill, expire in pigment, and raven lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4916 identities would post 2233 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
